overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Every station in the tenant — revenue, utilisation and what needs attention
overview.noActivityMessage: Bookings will appear here per station.

records.customersSubtitle: Everyone who has used the service
records.paymentsSubtitle: Every transaction recorded across the tenant
records.activitySubtitle: Traceability — every override, reassignment and verification is recorded here
records.customersHint: They appear here after their first booking.
records.paymentsHint: Transactions appear here as they are taken.
records.title: Rentals

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Accounts, roles and station assignments
team.inviteNote: They get an email to choose their own password — you never set one for them.
team.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be emailed
team.inviteLinkHint: It works once and expires in three days.
team.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Hand it over in person — it is not emailed.
team.stationHint: Where they work — scopes everything they see.
team.activitiesHint: An agent only sees the activities you pick here — nothing else reaches their screen.
team.kioskHint: A Shop & Drop agent answers for one kiosk — this is the one.

roleOption.AGENT: Agent — runs the counter for one activity
roleOption.CASHIER: Cashier — the till: payments, refunds, drawer
roleOption.DELIVERY_AGENT: Delivery agent — takes bags to customers
roleOption.HR: HR — records costs, suppliers and payroll

team.reportsToHint: A manager or supervisor may sit under the project manager.
team.pickActivityFirst: Choose the activity first — the desks follow from it.
team.noKioskForActivity: No desk at that station runs this activity yet.

org.title: Organisation
org.subtitle: Sites, stations and kiosks — the physical structure of the business
org.noSitesMessage: Add your first venue to get started.
org.codeHint: Short label shown on receipts, e.g. KKIA-T1.
org.servicesHint: Which engines this station may sell.
org.locationHint: Where in the station it physically stands.
org.deactivateNote: Levels are deactivated, never deleted — past bookings keep resolving.
org.kioskActivityHint: A desk runs exactly one: its stock, its agents and its takings all hang off it.
org.stationHasNoActivity: Give the station an activity before adding a desk to it.
org.removeKioskSubtitle: The desk record goes; nothing that was on it does.
org.removeKioskBody: A desk can only be removed once it holds no stock, no staff and no live session. If any of those are still true the platform will refuse and tell you which.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: What customers are charged, per service
pricing.billingHint: How the base price is multiplied.
pricing.priceNote: Running sessions keep the price they were sold at.
pricing.note: Prices are copied onto a booking when it is created, so a change here applies to <1>new bookings only</1> — sessions already running keep the price they were sold at. VAT is {{vat}}% and is calculated on top in Settings.
pricing.ratesHint: A product can be sold by the hour, by the tour, or both — the counter picks which at the point of sale.
pricing.hourlyHint: Left empty, the base price is the hourly rate.
pricing.perTourHint: Leave it empty and this product is not sold by the tour.
pricing.tourMinutesHint: How long one tour runs. Defaults to 60.

estate.title: Estate
estate.subtitle: Physical capacity across every station — utilisation and provisioning
estate.identifierNote: Identifiers continue the existing series — they never restart at 01.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Revenue, occupancy and rental activity
reports.noOccupancyHint: Nothing has been provisioned for this activity yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company details, operating rules and the channels your counter may use
settings.graceHint: Free minutes after a session ends.
settings.secretsNote: Provider credentials (WhatsApp, SMTP) are deployment secrets and are intentionally <1>not editable here</1> — a web form for them would let anyone with a manager session redirect the codes that protect customers’ property. Ask an administrator to change them in the environment.
settings.savedDetail: New bookings use these values immediately.

operations.liveSubtitle: Everything running right now, across all stations
operations.incidentsSubtitle: Every exception raised across the tenant
operations.blindCountNote: A blind count that does not match stays open until a supervisor or manager records a resolution.
operations.noShiftsHint: Shifts open by agents will appear here.
operations.awaitingApproval_one: {{count}} till is waiting for a variance to be settled
operations.awaitingApproval_other: {{count}} tills are waiting for a variance to be settled
operations.openOneToSettle: Open one to see what moved through it, and settle it with a note.
operations.stillOpenHint: A drawer nobody closed can be counted and closed from its own page.

shifts.noTakings: Nothing was taken on this till
shifts.noTakingsHint: No payment has been booked against this drawer.
shifts.noDrawer: This till has no drawer breakdown.
shifts.resolveBlurb: The drawer is out by {{amount}}. Say what was found, and it closes.
shifts.noteHint: This stays on the shift, so the next person reading it knows why it closed as it did.
shifts.forceCloseTitle: Close a till that was left open
shifts.forceCloseBlurb: {{name}} never closed this drawer. Count what is in it and close it in your name.
shifts.countedHint: The platform expects {{amount}}. Enter what is actually there.
shifts.forceNoteHint: Why you are closing it for them — a forgotten till, an agent who left early.
